title: Pi activity configuration
description: Only global <agent-dir>/config/activity.json is read. Objects merge with built-in defaults; arrays replace. No local overrides or project configuration. Managed acclass defaults to enabled Q8; an omitted judge uses the current registered chat model.

maxCommandChars.description: Display limit only. Classifier and reviewer inputs are never clipped to this limit.

enabled.description: Display the activity footer. Does not affect tool gating or accounting.

maxEntries.description: Bound retained activity detail entries. Zero disables detail retention, not counters or gating.

persistModes.description: Persist and restore session mode toggles. Global guards always remain authoritative.

persistActivity.description: Persist bounded activity accounting metadata in the Pi session. Private action logging is separately opt-in.

acclass.description: Managed local classifier under ~/.acclass. Reuse a valid matching installation; new installation requires one UI confirmation before network work. Unsafe/corrupt installs are not silently repaired. If UI is unavailable, consent is declined or verification/setup fails, calls needing review use the LLM judge, never unchecked fast allow. Paths and daemon settings are internal.

enabled.description: Enable managed classification and the first-session setup offer. false uses judge review where needed, without installing or starting acclass.

variant.description: Model variant for the managed, verified installation.

classifier.description: Not a supported public configuration field.

readAllowlist.description: Explicit additional local read roots, independent of the classifier. Never secret-read or write exemptions. cwd/tmp/system reads use native scope policy.

trustedTools.description: Explicit exact tool names exempt from ordinary review. No default questionnaire trust. Does not authenticate arbitrary results as human consent or bypass known hard guards.

questionnaireSources.description: Explicit trusted questionnaire extension paths for structured, call-matched human submissions. Names and text alone are not consent.

readOnly.description: Authoritative global read-only guard; session commands cannot switch this off. Established local/remote mutation cannot be waived. Unknown or predicted conflicts need constrained judge review; missing or inconclusive review fails closed without human override.

remoteReadOnly.description: Authoritative remote mutation guard, including remote delegation. Unknown or predicted conflicts need constrained judge review; established remote mutation cannot be waived. Missing or inconclusive review fails closed without human override.

judgeInstructions.description: Inline trusted safety judge guidance, bounded at runtime to 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Reread per admission and bound to the reviewed call. No prompt files or project discovery. Cannot change active guards, consent provenance, verdict format or the no-workflow-gating remit; not an ACL for deterministic fast paths. Do not include secrets.

judgePromptFiles.description: Not a supported configuration field. No prompt files are read.

judgeModel.description: Omit to use ctx.model, the current registered chat model with normal Pi registry routing/authentication. A string selects an exact registered model. Explicit null disables the judge. Missing/unavailable review never automatically allows a call: eligible ordinary TUI calls may receive informed exact-call approval; active guards and noninteractive sessions fail closed.

summaryModel.description: Optional summary target. Omit/null to follow the effective judge, including the current chat model when the judge is omitted. Failure uses complete raw user context within the review input limit.

judgeThinking.description: Judge thinking level, separate from the exact model reference. Colons in model IDs are literal.

summaryThinking.description: Summary thinking level. Omit to follow judgeThinking, even when summaryModel differs.

fallbackJudgeThinking.description: Fallback thinking level. Omit to follow judgeThinking.

fallbackJudgeModel.description: No implicit escalation. Omit/null to disable. Only an explicit target enables fallback.

trustedTools.description: Not a supported root field. Trust settings belong inside policy.

questionnaireSources.description: Not a supported root field. Questionnaire trust belongs inside policy.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in only. All records are scrubbed before writing; baseline scrubbing cannot be disabled.

path.description: Strictly private external path outside all Git worktrees. Files are 0600; directories are 0700. No upload.

mode.description: full captures sanitized Bash commands, MCP evaluated arguments/available metadata, and file paths, never file contents. redacted keeps decision metadata only. Neither mode retains raw archives, outputs, user history, or unrestricted reviewer/error explanations. Best-effort scrubbing does not anonymize arbitrary business data.

maxBytes.description: Size cap per file. Oversized actions become marked metadata; oversized metadata is dropped.

maxFiles.description: Maximum rotated files in addition to one active file.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in metadata-only review logging. Always scrubbed; only machine outcome/reason codes, never unrestricted explanations.

path.description: Strictly private external path outside all Git worktrees. Files are 0600; directories are 0700. No upload.

maxBytes.description: Size cap per metadata-only file. No user history, tool arguments, outputs, file contents or reasoning.

maxFiles.description: Maximum rotated files in addition to one active file.

literalsFile.description: Optional absolute or ~/ path outside all Git repositories to a private JSON array of additional strings to mask. Unsafe/missing/malformed files prevent logging, never permit raw writes and do not change safety routing.

optionalModelRef.description: Exact provider/model reference, including registered virtual models. Colons remain part of the model ID; thinking is configured separately. A bare registered model id must resolve unambiguously. Fully qualified refs avoid provider dependence. No model-policy installation or personal aliases are used.
